title: Script stack pointer relocation
summary: Recover VA 0x4f4e60 (142 bytes) as a register-fastcall ScriptState member. Rebase top, linked open-upvalue values, three fields in each inclusive 24-byte frame, then base. Preserve 32-bit wraparound and offset rounding to eight bytes. Caller disassembly confirms the new stack is installed before this call; allocation and stack contents are outside this routine.
test_description: 720 direct original-versus-source cases at identical fixture addresses; independently calculated expected values and whole-fixture comparisons. Empty through five-element frame/upvalue ranges, unequal counts, inclusive and non-frame-aligned end bounds, positive/negative/unaligned/extreme offsets, upward/downward/no-op moves, and modulo-32-bit wraparound. Checks all untouched state words, list links, unused nodes/frames and canaries. Installs test-owned FS backing and checks its head after every oracle call.
known_limits: Names of Lua-like state/frame/upvalue fields are inferred from access and caller behavior; unknown fields remain explicit padding words.
Addresses are explicit 32-bit game addresses; a native 64-bit port must supply address translation or adapt layouts and arithmetic deliberately.

Valid readable/writable finite linked lists and frame ranges are required just as in the original; invalid pointers, cycles, wrapping frame iteration and overlapping structural storage are not tested.
No whole-game execution, allocator behavior, byte-match claim or recovery outside the assigned routine.
